description: This file is a shell script library for performance testing in a Git-related project. It sets up environment variables, defines functions for creating and managing repositories, running performance tests, and handling test infrastructure. It is intended to be sourced by other test scripts rather than executed directly.

methods.name: die_if_build_dir_not_repo
methods.description: Checks if the build directory is a Git repository, exits if not.

methods.name: test_perf_copy_repo_contents
methods.description: Copies repository contents from a source directory, excluding certain special directories.

methods.name: test_perf_create_repo_from
methods.description: Creates a new repository by copying from an existing source repository, establishing the correct structure.

methods.name: test_perf_fresh_repo
methods.description: Initializes a new, fresh repository in a specified location.

methods.name: test_perf_default_repo
methods.description: Creates a repository from the default GIT_PERF_REPO.

methods.name: test_perf_large_repo
methods.description: Creates a large repository from GIT_PERF_LARGE_REPO for performance testing.

methods.name: test_checkout_worktree
methods.description: Checks out all files in the repository's index.

methods.name: test_run_perf_
methods.description: Runs a performance test command with timing.

methods.name: test_wrapper_
methods.description: Wraps a test function with setup, prerequisites, and result handling.

methods.name: test_perf_
methods.description: Performs a performance measurement, repeats timing, and logs results.

methods.name: test_at_end_hook_
methods.description: Hook to run at the end of tests to aggregate results.
